description: This file is the main frontend component for a Tic Tac Toe game built with React Native. It manages game state, user interactions, AI opponent logic using minimax, and renders the UI including the game grid, score, mode selection, and controls.

methods.name: checkWinner
methods.description: Checks the current game board for a winner based on predefined winning lines.

methods.name: getEmptyIndices
methods.description: Returns the list of indices in the board that are not yet occupied.

methods.name: minimax
methods.description: Implements the minimax algorithm with pruning to determine the best move for AI.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: Component displaying the main header with game title and optional subtitle.

methods.name: SegmentedControl
methods.description: Component that allows switching between game modes (PvP, PvAI).

methods.name: ScoreCard
methods.description: Displays the current score for X, O, and draw counts.

methods.name: Cell
methods.description: Represents each cell in the Tic Tac Toe grid, handling press interactions and display.

methods.name: BoardGrid
methods.description: Renders the 3x3 game grid with cells, highlighting winning line if present.

methods.name: PrimaryButton
methods.description: A styled button component for game controls.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React Native component that manages the game state, user interaction, AI logic, and rendering of the entire application.
